privacy.admin.body: Your name, email, account status, when you were last active and how many sources you've connected. Never your financial data.
privacy.admin.title: What the administrator sees
privacy.bans.body: If the administrator bans an email address, {appName} keeps that address (and nothing else) so it can't be invited again, until the ban is lifted.
privacy.bans.title: If an address is banned
privacy.collected.body: Your email address, your name, your language, time zone and base currency; how you sign in (a password stored only as a secure hash, and the Google account you connect, if any); whether two-step verification is on (its secret is encrypted); the devices you're signed in on (a label such as "Chrome on Windows", never your IP address); and a 90-day history of security events such as sign-ins and password changes. Everything you record in {appName} (accounts, transactions, budgets) is kept so the app can show it to you.
privacy.collected.title: What we keep
privacy.contact.body: Contact the person who invited you, or the {appName} administrator.
privacy.contact.title: Questions
privacy.deletion.body: You can delete your account from Settings. You have 7 days to change your mind; after that everything you own is erased. Entries you added to shared accounts stay, shown as "Deleted user". Backups that still contain your data are gone within 14 days of the erasure.
privacy.deletion.title: Deleting your account
privacy.emails.body: Only about your account: invitations, password resets, security notices and deletion notices. No newsletters or tracking.
privacy.emails.title: Emails we send
privacy.export.body: You can download everything as CSV and JSON at any time from Settings > Your data.
privacy.export.title: Your data is yours
privacy.google.body: If you sign in with Google, {appName} receives your Google account's ID, email address and name, and uses them only to sign you in. It keeps no Google access tokens for sign-in. Connecting a Gmail inbox for capture is separate and asks for its own permission.
privacy.google.title: Signing in with Google
privacy.intro.body: {appName} is run by one person for a small invited group. This notice says what {appName} keeps about you, why, and what you can do about it. Last updated {date}.
